name: poster-style-transfer
title_zh: 把一张海报的设计系统拆出来，移植到你的新主题上
tagline_zh: 上传参考海报，自动提取配色、字体、版式与构图规则，再按你的新标题、副标题或文案生成一张风格统一的新海报。
tagline_en: Upload a reference poster, extract its color, type, layout, and composition rules, then generate a new poster.
desc_en: Analyze an uploaded or local reference poster, extract its reusable design system, and transpose that system to an original poster with a new theme, title, subtitle, or campaign copy.
why_zh: 不是滤镜叠加，而是把设计决策拆成可复用的系统——从网格到字重、从留白到对比，逐层迁移。
why_en: Not a filter overlay—it decomposes design decisions into a reusable system, migrating grid, type weight, whitespace, and.
limit_zh: 只处理静态海报（JPG/PNG/PDF），不生成动效或交互稿；需要你提供明确的参考图与主题文案，否则输出会停在草稿阶段。
limit_en: Static posters only (JPG/PNG/PDF); no motion or interactive output. Requires a clear reference image and copy—otherwise output stays at draft stage.
